page: Microsoft Azure D2ds_v6 is a general-purpose virtual machine powered by an Intel Xeon 8573C processor built on the x86_64 architecture. It features 2 dedicated vCPUs derived from a single physical core with hyper-threading enabled, running at a clock speed of 4.2 GHz. The processor configuration includes 48 KB of L1d cache, 2 MB of L2 cache, and a large 260 MB L3 cache. It supports advanced instruction sets including AVX-512 and Intel Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX) for tile and INT8 operations.

The instance is equipped with 8.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of 4.0 GB of RAM per vCPU. Local storage is provided via a bundled 118 GB NVMe SSD, and the instance is capable of utilizing Premium Storage. It does not include any GPU hardware or complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Benchmark data indicates strong single-core performance, with a Geekbench single-core score of 2105.0 and average single-threaded compression and decompression speeds. However, multi-core scaling and memory bandwidth are relatively limited. The stress-ng multi-core performance, uncached memory read/write bandwidth, and database operations fall into the lower performance tiers.

This virtual machine offers a qualitative balance of high clock-speed single-core compute and fast local storage. It is best suited for lightweight general-purpose workloads, single-threaded processing tasks, basic web serving, and small-scale development or testing environments that do not require extensive multi-core parallelization.
